name: NanoVolumeHDDA
definition: A span-merging hierarchical DDA iterator over a NanoGrid that yields TimeSpan structs representing merged active regions along a ray in front-to-back order. It merges adjacent active leaves and tiles to eliminate seam artifacts at 8-voxel tile edges.
summary: NanoVolumeHDDA is a zero-allocation iterator that traverses NanoGrids along rays to yield merged active spans via callback, eliminating seam artifacts at tile edges.
